_comment: Test scenario for LAMBDA: images from the source "EO optical (fictional)" (the Syria convoy demo, with locations) in a layer named "Satellite", drawn from their own location.point. recent_days, limit and layer are read by hl/items.py and not sent to HL API; APP_ITEMS_PER_TYPE overrides limit. No location entities exist on LAMBDA, so the Location layer stays empty. all_fields: every populated i360 item field is shown (table without media fields, viewer with everything).
